exercise.label: Transfer
exercise.task: The supplied shelter draft calculates mean weight by species from every pet record and draws exact bars labelled "Pet adoption", "species" and "Mean weight". Its y-axis starts at 1. Use the report’s common linear range from 0 to 25; every group mean fits inside that range. Keep every group and its actual mean weight; arrange and display fig.
exercise.starter: # Repair the draft’s y-axis, then arrange and display fig
exercise.hint: Use ax.set_ylim(0, 25) to match the report range. Dog mean weight is 20.25, so this upper bound keeps it visible.

import pandas as pd

data = {
    "name": ["Milo", "Pepper", "Luna", "Bean", "Rex", "Nori"],
    "species": ["Cat", "Dog", "Cat", "Rabbit", "Dog", "Rabbit"],
    "age": [3, 7, 2, 4, 5, 1],
    "weight": [4.2, 18.5, 3.6, 2.4, 22, 1.8],
    "room": ["A", "B", "A", "B", "A", "B"],
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
means = df.groupby("species")["weight"].mean()
ax.bar(means.index, means.values)
ax.set(title="Pet adoption", xlabel="species", ylabel="Mean weight")
ax.set_ylim(1, 25)
